coverage_notes.summary: Twelve targeted searches covered sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure or major access reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption. No new U.S. event in the bounded window met the qualifying criteria.
exclusions_observed: Eastport, Maine only-grocery-store closure reporting was several weeks old and outside the bounded window.
Kauaʻi emergency food distributions were reported as proceeding as scheduled rather than canceled or suspended.
Searches for pantry/food-bank closures surfaced older or non-U.S. items rather than a new qualifying U.S. access reduction.
SNAP/WIC searches did not surface a new official interruption with immediate access consequences in the bounded window.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is non-authoritative; production collection remains authoritative.
